content.comment_body: I need assistance. I am trying to install [product_name] [version_no] - Update in silent mode. With [product_name] [version_no] the silent installation worked without issues. The installer technology changed in [version_no], now using Installer Anywhere instead of Installer Shield. Are the standard parameters still valid?
Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. In your case, I would recommend starting a support request.

[product_name] is not intended for silent installation. There may be alternative solutions, but not from [company_name]. You could try accessing the Windows64 or 32 folder on the installation DVD and running softcomfort.exe. This won't install the software, but [product_name] will run.

Installing the software isn't the main issue; I need to install it in silent mode for software distribution purposes. Can anyone assist with configuring a silent installation for [product_name] [version_no]?
Hello [user_name], are you aware this is an official statement from [company_name]?
Currently, no—are you sure? It's interesting that I could install [product_name] [version_no] silently, so why is it not possible with [version_no]?

analysis.insight_summary: Users find that the latest update to [product_name] has removed support for silent installation, unlike the previous version which allowed unattended installs. This change in the installer impacts those using software distribution tools for deployment.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the new version of [product_name] to maintain silent installation capability to enable automated deployment using their current software distribution systems.
